messages.subject: Travel clock started
messages.body: Twenty-four out. Three repair. Twenty-four back. The travel clock is running and the rover carries seventy-two hours of independent supplies.

messages.subject: I have the garden
messages.body: I have the garden. Amara has the station. Send position packets; we will answer every one.

messages.subject: The return is already in the battery
messages.body: The shorter line looked cheaper until Rafi laid the slope map over it. We take the surveyed road, and the energy to come back is counted before we leave.

messages.subject: Road, not shortcut
messages.body: A reserve cannot rescue an impossible road. Cruise begins on the surveyed road.

messages.subject: Position packet received
messages.body: Position packet received. You are on the surveyed road, on time. The garden is fine and so are we.

messages.subject: Marker two is dark
messages.body: Marker two is dark. Brake set at the surveyed pad. We match markers to the map, not to silhouettes. Suit and tether checks next.

messages.subject: Repeaters
messages.body: Radio needs a clear line. Repeaters along the road pass the signal hop by hop around the terrain; one dark marker breaks the chain for everyone behind it.

messages.subject: Light is not yet a link
messages.body: Repeater battery replaced, power isolated first. Both neighbours tested, so it is a link and not just a light. Control returns to Aurora while we drive on.

messages.subject: Field position held
messages.body: Field position recorded on the time card. Aurora has the watch for the night ahead.

messages.subject: Same darkness, different garden
messages.body: The final thirty-six-hour night has started. Home forecast checked against the independent gauge. The guide light is exactly where we planned it. Two here until the return.

messages.subject: Different us
messages.body: Same darkness, different garden, different us. Then five for the last three hours.

messages.subject: Summit reached
messages.body: Summit reached. Three aboard. The relay housing is dark beyond the window. Repair window opens now.

messages.subject: Home first
messages.body: Home checks first: air, temperature, return path. Then the summit packet was acknowledged.

messages.subject: The spare has a history
messages.body: My December note was still in the crate. Connectors and serial checked again anyway. Power isolated, zero verified, housing closed before reconnecting. The antenna panel just woke up.

messages.subject: Two unverified channels
messages.body: Two signal panels live, neither verified yet. Aurora first.

messages.subject: Both shores
messages.body: Local leg to Aurora locked, then the Earth leg with obstruction checked. Both shores, not just the bright one.

messages.subject: Line of sight
messages.body: A picture of Earth above a ridge does not prove the base below can hear you. A relay must see both ends.

messages.subject: Exact match
messages.body: ALO42 sent, exact match returned. Strong is not the same as correct, and this was correct. The transmit button is ready for a voice.

messages.subject: Telemetry
messages.body: Current telemetry follows through the relay. Now verify the voices at both ends.

messages.subject: Route restored
messages.body: Aurora, Earth desk. The route through Malapert is restored and logged. Thank you for leaving room on the channel. Drive home safely.

messages.subject: Return departure
messages.body: Return departs now: same road, new timestamps. Return is part of the mission.

messages.subject: Five home
messages.body: Five home. Ferreira's mug is back beside the others. Three hours to first light.

messages.subject: Arrivals checked
messages.body: Three arrivals expected and checked. Provisions used against the forecast are in the report.

messages.subject: By the window
messages.body: Show me the cotton by the window.

messages.subject: What we grew
messages.body: Temperature and pressure steady. Thirty founder seeds protected, eleven vault specimens kept, everyone home. The shutter is open. Thank you for growing this with us.
